title: Kamishiro Rui — Carefree Prodigy〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-B

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Hm... I may not be able to do all the lighting effects I want with the number of illuminations on Wonder Stage...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (The lighting effects that can be done on an outdoor stage like that are quite limited to begin with. And I have to try to match them to Tsukasa's image as well...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: (Kamishiro never takes notes in class. He's usually doodling or writing some kind of formula instead...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I know. We just have to figure out the optimal amount of light needed according to the weather that day. I'll get Tsukasa to help me with the calculations later...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: (Whoa. He just broke into a smile over nothing. He's as crazy as the rumors say...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's see... Is Tsukasa in his classroom?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui! Just the person I was looking for!
I need to talk to you about something.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
So do I, but let's hear what you have to say first.
Go ahead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hehehe... Look at this!
It's a flyer publicizing our show!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Wow, when did you come up with that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
A future star must always look ahead!
What do you think? Not bad for something hand drawn, eh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, it's quite well done, actually.
You're surprisingly good at this.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why is it surprising?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, I need you to help me fold them all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that would make them easier to distribute. But since you're asking for help, there must be quite a lot of flyers to fold, then?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. That whole stack over there. Right there!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Right... That's a lot of flyers.
There must be hundreds.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Come on, this should be quick and easy with two of us!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No thanks.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I refuse to do something so inefficient. We can't finish folding so many flyers before school ends. This is just going to be a giant waste of time.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wh-What are you saying?! These flyers will help to publicize our show! And you're calling them a waste of time?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well, let me finish. The thing is, we don't have to do it ourselves, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly what I just said. Well then, I'll see you again at the next break time, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We can talk about what I want later.)
Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hey, thanks for waiting. Here's what you need.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Rui!
Wait, what's that little printer-like device for?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A flyer folding machine I made from the robots I had on hand and equipment borrowed from the school's garbage pile.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Put the machine on the desk and secure this arm to the desk edge. The arm will serve as the tray for folded flyers.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh huh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It uses the robot's battery so you don't have to plug it in. Then, feed the flyer into the insertion part and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Whoa! The paper got sucked inside! Wow...
And it came back out folded in half!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The folded paper landed perfectly inside the arm!
No need to worry about them scattering everywhere like that!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly. Basically, all you have to do is feed the paper into the machine. Easy, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Indeed!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, it's just a simplified version of the folding machines available on the market, but the functionality is there. Only for folding flyers, though.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not bad at all, Rui!
You made this during class just now?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. And I finished it sooner than expected, so I input a paper airplane folding function into the robot's AI as well.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: O-Okay. Not sure what that means, but it sounds awesome!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. Keep the machine going throughout your classes and the flyers should be all folded by the time school's over.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it! Thanks, Rui!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, thank you for providing a place for the machine!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? You're welcome?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He usually gives me a hard time because of his strange ideas, but he can be quite helpful when needed, huh?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now, I just have to feed the flyers into the machine and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? Wait a minute.
Did he just say I needed to keep the machine going throughout my classes?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He wants me to keep folding the flyers at my seat?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah! That's what he meant by providing a place... C-Curses!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Rui! You little...
I can't take my classes like this!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe...
